comment: Divergences from the gophertunnel oracle that are reviewed and accepted. Anything NOT listed here fails the wire-conformance gate. Each entry must say why it is acceptable and what would resolve it; 'we did not get to it' is not a reason to add one.

packets.name: HurtArmor
packets.reason: Oracle conflict, resolved AGAINST gophertunnel. gophertunnel writes ArmourSlots as Varint64 (ZigZag64); Cloudburst writes writeUnsignedLong and the endstone BDS dump types it uvarint64. Two independent sources say unsigned, so this is very likely a gophertunnel bug worth reporting upstream rather than a generator defect. Kept visible until that is confirmed.

packets.name: SubChunk
packets.reason: False positive from comparison granularity, not a wire difference. The heightmap is a 2D 16x16 array of int8 in both Mojang's schema and endstone's dump (repeat count 16 of repeat count 16), and the generator emits exactly that; gophertunnel stores the same 256 bytes flat. Deliberately NOT changed in the generator - matching the documented shape is worth more than satisfying the comparator. Resolve by teaching compare.mjs to flatten nested fixed arrays.

packets.name: StructureBlockUpdate
packets.reason: Optionality conflict. gophertunnel packet/structure_block_update.go writes StructureName and FilteredStructureName unconditionally as two plain strings; the endstone dump marks the redacted name optional, adding a presence Bool. Needs a capture to settle which the server actually emits.

packets.name: EducationSettings
packets.reason: Optionality/position conflict. Both sources agree the packet HAS optionals - gophertunnel packet/education_settings.go uses OptionalFunc for CanModifyBlocks and OverrideURI and OptionalMarshaler for ExternalLinkSettings - but the presence boundaries land at different positions, so the sequences do not align. Needs per-field adjudication rather than a blanket rule.

packets.name: UpdateAbilities
packets.reason: Oracle conflict over an array prefix. gophertunnel ability.go writes Layers with SliceUint8Length (a U8 count); the endstone dump says repeat prefix uvarint32. Mojang's raw schema states no prefix override, which implies the varint default, so it is NOT independent corroboration of the U8 - our earlier U8 correction was itself derived from gophertunnel. Genuinely one-versus-one; needs a capture.

packets.name: EditorNetwork
packets.reason: Structural disagreement. gophertunnel packet/editor_network.go writes a single NetworkLittleEndian NBT payload; the endstone dump models a raw variant name and data pair. These are not the same bytes, so one source is modelling the payload's interior rather than its wire form. Needs a capture.

packets.name: CameraPresets
packets.reason: Deeply nested camera preset payload; remaining differences are optional presence inside nested preset definitions. Needs per-field adjudication.

packets.name: ServerboundDiagnostics
packets.reason: The endstone dump carries an optional System Categories block that gophertunnel does not implement at all. A field present in the server dump but absent from a hand-written client is the expected direction for a newly added field, so this is likely gophertunnel lagging rather than a generator defect - but it is unverified.

packets.name: ServerPresenceInfo
packets.reason: The two sources describe different types. gophertunnel's PresenceInfo (server_join_information.go) has ExperienceName and WorldName as optionals plus an unconditional RichPresenceID; endstone's ServerConfiguration::PresenceConfiguration documents only an optional richPresenceId. Our output therefore omits fields gophertunnel writes. This is the one divergence whose direction could truncate a packet, so it should be settled by capture before anything ships on it.
